candidates.explanation: The new-email verification link is built with the path '/confirm-email', which is the same page the sign-up activation mail uses. The e2e test expects '/confirm-new-email?hash=...'. The frontend's confirm-email page calls the sign-up confirm endpoint, not the confirm-new-email endpoint (AuthService.confirmNewEmail). So the email change never completes.

fix.description: Change the URL path in confirmNewEmail from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
